units.source_text: 女人身上的沙子流了下来，他看到了她的肩膀、手臂、侧腹和腰的一部分肌肤。

en.t: The sand slid down from the woman's body, and he saw the skin of her shoulders, arms, side, and part of her waist.

units.source_text: 但现在实在不是偷看女人的时候。

en.t: But this was really no time to be stealing glances at the woman.

units.source_text: 他走过去，掀掉她脸上的手巾。

en.t: He went over and pulled the towel from her face.

units.source_text: 脸上一块块斑，和沙子包裹的身体比较起来，活生生的，令人毛骨悚然。

en.t: The blotches on her face, compared with her body wrapped in sand, looked vividly alive and made his skin crawl.

units.source_text: 昨晚灯光下她的肤色分外白，原来那是化妆的关系呀。

en.t: Last night under the light her complexion had looked especially white; it turned out that was because of makeup.

units.source_text: 眼前那白白的粉东一块，西一块地剥落，像一块块秃斑。

en.t: Before his eyes, the white powder was peeling off here and there, like patches of baldness.

units.source_text: 他觉得那秃斑，像不用鸡蛋清裹的便宜货炸肉排，

en.t: To him, those bald patches looked like cheap cutlets made without a coating of egg white,

units.source_text: 那令人意外的白，大概是真正的小麦粉吧。

en.t: and that unexpected whiteness was probably real wheat flour.
